name: south_kensington_core008_web.glb
note: The packed South Kensington core008 city model (meshopt + KHR_mesh_quantization, glTF Y up, metres), split into parts under GitHub's 100 MB file limit. Concatenate the parts in order to get the .glb; the viewer does this in the browser (viewer/model-source.js). Served by GitHub Pages with CORS enabled.
